title: KEEL STRATEGY PIVOT (AKL 48-36-336) [95]
style: UK garage meets broken beat and jazz-funk, 95 BPM with 2-step swing, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), bilingual chop weave English + te reo Maori + French, shuffled hi-hats with ghost snares, jazzy Rhodes chords, walking sub bass with slide notes, muted trumpet stabs, vinyl crackle, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, late-night Auckland-rooftop mood, sidechain ducking pads to kick, sophisticated club 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(vinyl crackle, Rhodes chord stab, swung hats)
(KEEL... STRA... TE... GY...)
(piv... ot... piv... ot...)
(AKL... quarante-huit... trente-six...)

[Build]
(sub bass slides in, ghost snares ramp)
KEEL — STRA — TE — GY!
PIV — OT — NOW!
AKL! AKL! 48! 36!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(muted trumpet stab, snare roll)

[Drop 1]
(2-step kick-snare pattern, walking sub)
PIV — OT!
FOR — TY — EIGHT!
THIR — TY — SIX!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
(chop stack +7) yes-yes-oui-oui / ae-ae-yes-yes
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(Rhodes solo phrase, chops trade left-right)
(where?) (now?) (go?)
(où?) (quand?) (allons!)
(kei hea?) (haere!) (āe!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE MAP —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to Rhodes + sub pulse, no drums)
(whispered) keel... strategy...
(soft) pivot... pivot...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
AKL... 48... 36...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(snare ghost roll builds)

[Drop 2]
(full 2-step swing, trumpet doubled)
KEEL — STRA — TE — GY! (pivot pivot!)
FOR — TY — EIGHT! (oui oui!)
THIR — TY — SIX! (āe āe!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(swing fades, Rhodes resolves)
(keel... strategy... pivot...)
(AKL... 48... 36... 336...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(vinyl crackle out)
